purpose: Score new closed V1.7 12H keys with the already fitted test_2026 LightGBM booster, without reading any trade outcome or fitting new parameters.
single_variable: Calendar extension only; generate current source features on native hourly aggregates, including the exact sum of 5m close times base volume, native BTC returns/EMA, original source age, and simultaneous raw-signal count over the original score model's 632-contract universe. Formerly unscored supplemental instruments stay unscored.
parity: Validate reconstructed probabilities against the published 2026 out-of-time probabilities on common Aug/September observations prior to 2026-09-22. Supply actual aligned 5m volume/turnover for the warmup. Retain a candidate as unscored when new valid volume or cross-venue context is unavailable. No earlier score is retroactively changed.
